授業概要
言語学，とりわけ，音韻論や形態論に関わる基本的な文献を精読し，当該領域の諸問題について議論する．
We will peruse basic literature on phonology and morphology written in Japanese, discussing various issues and topics of this field.

全体の教育目標
Students will learn to acquire basic knowledge on general linguistics, especially phonology and morphology. The goals of this course are to:
(1) understand major terms and fundamental concepts in linguistics and
(2) enhance the ability to read academic texts critically and the skill in making an oral presentation.
